names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 6 decembrie, «Sfântul Ierarh Nicolae, Arhiepiscopul Mirelor Lichiei», with the rank word and the see left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 6 Δεκεμβρίου, «Άγιος Νικόλαος Αρχιεπίσκοπος Μύρων της Λυκίας, ο Θαυματουργός», with the rank and the see left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 6. децембар ст. ст., „Свети Николај Чудотворац, архиепископ мирликијски.“ — with «Свети» (“saint”), «Чудотворац» (the `wonderworker` grade BRIEF-SERBIAN §5 maps and `types` keeps) and «архиепископ мирликијски» (a rank and a see) all left off, which leaves the bare personal name. That stripping is the one this corpus has already made on him: the Greek form stored here is the bare «Νικόλαος», read off saint.gr’s «Άγιος Νικόλαος Αρχιεπίσκοπος Μύρων της Λυκίας, ο Θαυματουργός» with the Wonderworker taken off in the same way. The fold the bare string joins is keyed in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` at five members in this commit.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 6 decembrie — «Sfântul Ierarh Nicolae, Arhiepiscopul Mirelor Lichiei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιος Νικόλαος Αρχιεπίσκοπος Μύρων της Λυκίας, ο Θαυματουργός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man: the archbishop of Myra in Lycia, born at Patara, who sat at the First Ecumenical Council. Its head line gives «(; - 330)», the year of his repose, which the folder did not hold. The page prints an apolytikion, a kontakion, an oikos and a kathisma; the apolytikion and the kontakion are taken and the other two are not kinds the schema holds. The apolytikion «Κανόνα πίστεως καὶ εἰκόνα πραότητος» is the common of a hierarch with his name set into it, printed under his name as his own service, so it is copied as the house rule for a common requires. The page also lists the many towns that hold him patron and the places that hold parts of his relics; none of that is drafted. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 19.12.2025 (6. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети Николај Чудотворац, архиепископ мирликијски.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry and the longest the Prologue has given any saint in this reader’s range; quoted whole with its closing full stop; URL year 2025. `types` UNTOUCHED: «архиепископ» is the `archbishop` held, «Чудотворац» the `wonderworker`, and `hierarch` was already there. `dates` WIDENED on the death from a flat 330 to 330–343, TWO BOOKS THIRTEEN YEARS APART: saint.gr heads him «(; - 330)» and says «μετά την κοίμησή του το 330 μ.Χ.»; this book closes «Упокојио се 6. децембра 343. године (в. 9. мај)». Nothing is chosen. NO BIRTH ADDED: saint.gr puts his birth in the third century and this book gives no year for it at all, so the folder stays without one. `related_add`: `nicholas-of-patara`, this day’s arrival, in both directions — the entry says he learnt the spiritual life «код свог стрица Николаја, епископа патарског» and was tonsured in the monastery of New Sion «основаном тим истим стрицем његовим», founded by that same uncle, which is a relation the book asserts twice. NO OTHER `related` ROW: `constantine-the-great` and `stephen-of-decani` were already there; his parents Теофан and Нона, the heretic Arius whom he struck at Nicaea, and the emperors Diocletian and Maximian are no folders this corpus holds. NO `locations`, and the folder has never held one — Patara, Myra and New Sion are three places. THE BOOK’S OWN CROSS-REFERENCE «в. 9. мај» is to its 9 May, the translation of his relics, which is OUTSIDE this reader’s range and is left for whoever reads that day; it is a cross-reference and not a second heading, so no second-day note was written on it. THE FOLD: §6’s stripping leaves the bare «Николај», which `sr-foldpred.mjs` measured at three other holders; with this day’s `nicholas-of-patara` the key in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` goes from three members to five in this commit, and the three-member key it replaces is deleted with its reading carried forward. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

death.note: **Two books thirteen years apart, and the interval holds both; it was a flat 330 before this reading.** saint.gr's head line reads «Αγιος Νικολαος Αρχιεπισκοπος Μυρων Της Λυκιας, ο Θαυματουργος (; - 330)» and the same page says «μετά την κοίμησή του το 330 μ.Χ.». The Охридски пролог за 6. децембар ст. ст. closes its entry „Упокојио се 6. децембра 343. године (в. 9. мај).“ — he reposed on 6 December 343. Both books agree that he was at the First Ecumenical Council of Nicaea, which was in 325, so neither year is impossible; nothing is chosen and the basis stays traditional. NO BIRTH YEAR: saint.gr puts his birth in the third century without a year and this book gives none at all.

hymns.text: Κανόνα πίστεως καὶ εἰκόνα πραότητος, ἐγκρατείας Διδάσκαλον, ἀνέδειξέ σε τῇ ποίμνῃ σου, ἡ τῶν πραγμάτων ἀλήθεια· διὰ τοῦτο ἐκτήσω τῇ ταπεινώσει τὰ ὑψηλά, τῇ πτωχείᾳ τὰ πλούσια. Πάτερ Ἱεράρχα Νικόλαε, πρέσβευε Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ, σωθῆναι τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’ — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιος Νικόλαος Αρχιεπίσκοπος Μύρων της Λυκίας, ο Θαυματουργός»; it is the common of a hierarch, printed under his name with his name in it.

english.text: The truth of things showed you to your flock a rule of faith, an image of meekness and a teacher of continence; and so by humility you gained the heights, by poverty the riches. Father and hierarch Nicholas, intercede with Christ our God that our souls be saved.

hymns.text: Ἐν τοῖς Μύροις Ἅγιε, ἱερουργὸς ἀνεδείχθης· τοῦ Χριστοῦ γὰρ Ὅσιε, τὸ Εὐαγγέλιον πληρώσας, ἔθηκας τὴν ψυχήν σου ὑπὲρ λαοῦ σου, ἔσωσας τοὺς ἀθώους ἐκ τοῦ θανάτου· διὰ τοῦτο ἡγιάσθης, ὡς μέγας μύστης Θεοῦ τῆς χάριτος.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον — on the page of «Άγιος Νικόλαος Αρχιεπίσκοπος Μύρων της Λυκίας, ο Θαυματουργός», and it names his see.

english.text: At Myra, holy one, you were shown forth as a priest; for having fulfilled the Gospel of Christ, venerable father, you laid down your soul for your people and saved the innocent from death. Therefore you were sanctified, as a great initiate of the grace of God.
